

== Biography ==

Mary J. Pierce was the first wife of Moses Thomas Glasgow. The inspected family-history typescript attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow states that Moses and Mary married on 5 November 1839 and had three children: [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley Glasgow]], and an infant John Cameron Glasgow. That infant is not identified with [[Glasgow-466|John Cameron Glasgow]], whose retained profile birth year is 1820. Mary died on 14 March 1846. Moses later married [[Thompson-63146|Martha Thompson]] in 1848; Martha was Lois and Robert’s stepmother, not their biological mother.

Mary’s exact birth and death records have not been inspected. The retrospective typescript contains minor date errors; its wording that Mary was “in her twenty-sixth year” means age 25 and is compatible with the retained birth before 1821. No vital fields are changed.

== Research Notes ==

The explicit first-marriage child group supports Mary as the mother of [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd]] and [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley]]. The two profile pairs are separately assessed at 93% within this retrospective source scope. Original birth entries have not been inspected.
